a.	The Company has not defaulted in repayment of loans or borrowings or in the payment of interest thereon to any lender. Hence reporting under clause 3(ix) (a) of order is not applicable.

b.	The company is not declared as wilful defaulter by any bank or financial institution or other lender.

c.	The company has not availed any term loan during the year and hence reporting under this clause is not applicable.

d.	On an overall examination of the financial statements of the company, company has not raised any funds on short term basis and hence reporting under this clause is not applicable.

e.	In our opinion and according to the information and explanation provided to us, the company has not taken any funds from any entity or person on account of or to meet the obligations of its subsidiaries, associates or joint ventures.

fraud.text:
a)	No fraud by the Company and no material fraud on the Company has been noticed or reported during the year.

b)	No report under sub-section (12) of section 143 of the Companies Act has been filed in Form ADT-4 as prescribed under rule 13 of Companies (Audit and Auditors) Rules, 2014 with the Central Government, during the year and up to the date of this report.

c)	According to the information & explanations and representation made by the management, no whistle blower complaints have been received during the year (and up to the date of this report) by the Company.

business_summary.text: Ind-Swift Laboratories Limited is a pharmaceutical company focused on finished dosage formulations (FDF) with a strong presence in export markets and growing CDMO partnerships.

call_points.text: CDMO partnerships with Viatris, Manx and Arrotex commercialized, expected to contribute ₹200-220 Cr in FY27
Export gross margins at 55%, with 18% EBITDA margin sustainable and potential to reach 21-22%
₹250 Cr cash to be deployed over 2.5 years, no plans for Synthimed divestment this year
FY30 vision targets ₹1500 Cr revenue and ₹200+ Cr net profit with sustainable margins

timeline.summary: HCP Investments disposed of a 7.5% stake in Ind-Swift Laboratories via open market transactions between April 13 and April 17, 2026.
Ind-Swift Laboratories announced postal ballot voting results passing executive appointments and designation changes on May 5, 2026.
Ind-Swift Laboratories reported a reduction in its preferential issue size to ₹255.61 crore following the lapse of 65 lakh warrants.
Navrattan Munjal (Promoter) confirmed no encumbrances by promoters or persons-in-concert on Ind-Swift Laboratories’ shares for FY2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹169.79 Cr, net profit ₹15.11 Cr (-93.2% YoY).
Q1FY27 earnings call held on August 17, 2026, discussing strong financial performance with 21% YoY revenue growth and 17.91% EBITDA margin
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹240.46 Cr, net profit ₹34.22 Cr (+328.3% YoY).
Ind-Swift Laboratories Ltd schedules Q2 FY2026-27 earnings call on **4 Nov 2026 at 16:00 IST** with **Gagan Agarwal (CFO), Shalika Malhotra (DGM Finance), Pardeep Verma (VP Corporate Affairs & CS)**.

status_history.evidence: Q2FY27 EBITDA margin reached 18.91%, meeting the 18% target.
